{{Top}}
The '''tumble hyperdrive''', also referred to as a '''tumbledrive''', was a prototypical hyperdrive developed by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] and the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]] circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]]. The unstable device allowed for jumps of variable distance and duration, hence the name. The [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Gossam Courivers]] used the drive to locate the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm not exactly sure how the tumbledrive works, but it doesn't sound particularly safe.|Dan Wallace|<ref name="Blog" />}}
The tumble hyperdrive first appeared in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. In the end notes on his blog, Wallace reveals that it was created to explain the Gossams' pre-Republic colonization of Felucia while minimizing the appearances of the hyperdrive before its established creation.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|145|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 3 of 5)}}</ref>
